Streamed responses may be silent for this long, default 300000 as in Pi. A response that is not streamed (a server that answers with plain JSON) must arrive within it only when set. 0 or "disabled" turns it off.
Retries after the first attempt (default 3); 0 means no retry.
Exponential: the delay doubles for each retry (default 2000).
Longest backoff wait (default 60000).
Wins over httpIdleTimeoutMs: the longest silence in a streamed response, or the longest wait for one that is not streamed.
Koine has one retry loop, set by retry.maxRetries; this provider-level count is accepted and not used.
A longer Retry-After ends the retries with an error; 0 removes the limit (default 60000).
